'''Zogrov''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] dockworker in [[Mos Eisley]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He was friends with [[Beeyon Nace]].

Around that time, he recruited a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to help rescue Nace's lover [[Eila (Twi'lek)|Eila]], although it was revealed she was conning him for the [[Ccalras Corporation]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Zogrov appears in in [[West End Games]]' [[1997]] ''[[Mos Eisley Adventure Set]]''.
